query: After 42 hpf, microglial precursors detach from hyaloid blood vessels and start to infiltrate the neural retina. Furthermore, we conducted two sets of experiments: the first was cell transplantation from wild-type donor cells into slbp1 mutant host retinas, which introduced neurogenic wild-type retinal cell columns in proliferative slbp1 mutant retinas, and the second was overexpression of NICD in wild-type retina, which introduced proliferative retinal cell columns in neurogenic retinas. Thus, neurogenesis is required for infiltration of microglial precursors into the neural retina after 42 hpf.
